primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The percentage of participants achieving IGA "success" is presented. Success is defined as a score of 0 ('clear') or 1 ('almost clear') plus a 2-point improvement at Week 8. The IGA is 5-point scale assessing the severity of seborrheic dermatitis with total scores ranging from 0 ('clear') to 4 ('severe') \[higher scores indicating greater severity\].
